edit.statement: 'Is part of' is not transitive: if A is part of B and B is part of C, it no longer follows that A is part of C.
edit.subject: part_of
edit.original: 'Is part of' is transitive: a part of a part of C is itself part of C.
edit.scope: Anatomical and cellular part-whole links; only chaining along 'is part of' changes.
